required_stages.description: Output initialisation: the output buffers contain o_nope / o_rope before the copy (device copy of o_* into the output; per-call or once-per-identity is the open review item).
Scatter-copy of kv_nope into out_nope at rows dest_loc[t] (each element read once, written once, no atomics).
Scatter-copy of kv_rope into out_rope at rows dest_loc[t]; s2 and s3 independent, may be one or two launches; returns (out_nope, out_rope).

forbidden_substitutions.message: writes into o_nope / o_rope mutate an input
host-side indexed copy replaces the scatter kernel
preprocessing of dest_loc (sort / inverse permutation) is forbidden
persistent output buffers keyed by input identity: open review item (policy b)

outputs.aliasing: none with any input; (out_nope, out_rope) have the shapes/dtypes of o_nope/o_rope; whether the same buffers may be returned across calls (rewritten in place) is the open review item

timing_boundary.notes: The output initialisation from o_* (read + write of both outputs) is inside run(); whether it is paid on every call or once per input identity is the open review item, and bytes_expr counts only the steady-state kv read + out write. Flattening views are metadata only.
